title: Convex hull property (Simon 6.2) from SupportInBall (6.1)
statement: Assume SupportInBall: for all n ≥ 1, ℓ, rectifiable n-varifolds V in E = ℝ^{n+ℓ}, H: E → E, ξ ∈ E and R ≥ 0, if V has generalized mean curvature H in E ∖ B_R(ξ) (B_R(ξ) the closed ball), n^{-1}|⟨H(x), x − ξ⟩| < 1 for μ_V-a.e. x ∈ E ∖ B_R(ξ), and spt V is compact, then spt V ⊆ B_R(ξ). Then ConvexHullProperty holds: if n ≥ 1, K ⊆ ℝ^{n+ℓ} is compact, spt V is compact and V is stationary in ℝ^{n+ℓ} ∖ K, then spt V ⊆ conv K.
